title: Special permit for bonus floor area at Studio 54, Manhattan
summary: This resolution approves a special permit letting Roundabout Theatre Company add about 187,783 square feet of bonus floor area in exchange for restoring the landmarked Studio 54 theater at 254 West 54th Street. The property is within the Special Midtown District's Theater Subdistrict in Manhattan Community District 5. The Council found no significant environmental impact, subject to conditions tied to hazardous materials and air quality.
